correctness_confidence.basis: All 18 Lean 4 theorems are verified with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, and zero Classical.choice, backed by exact rational Python verifiers across 16 canonical certificates and 43 unit tests.

novelty.basis: Provides the first rigorous independent mechanized and exact rational verification artifact for the negative resolution of the extension complexity additivity conjecture.

reproducibility.basis: Fully reproducible via a public GitHub repository containing Lean 4 code, exact-rational Python verifiers, JSON certificates, and pytest automation.

rigor.basis: Uncompromising zero-floating-point architecture with AST inspection, exact rational arithmetic, and exhaustive subsystem/cycle checks.

significance.basis: Mechanically validates the counterexample disproving the 2013 Dagstuhl open conjecture on linear extension complexity additivity under Cartesian products.

strengths: Impeccable formal verification in Lean 4 with zero sorry and zero custom axioms.
Exact rational Python verifier architecture enforcing zero floating-point operations via AST inspection.
Comprehensive set of 16 canonical JSON certificates and 43 automated tests.
Clear structure connecting polyhedral constructions, matrix factorization bounds, and information-theoretic channel coding savings.
strong_novelty_candidates: Mechanized exact rational certification of extension complexity non-additivity under Cartesian products.
summary: This companion verification preprint presents a rigorous, zero-floating-point mechanized audit (EXT-COMPLEXITY-PROD-CERT-1.0) of Minhao Liu's negative resolution of the extension complexity additivity conjecture. Featuring 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems, an exact rational Python verifier, 16 canonical JSON certificates, and 43 tests, the work sets a gold standard for formal verification in polyhedral combinatorics.
weaknesses: Dense presentation of technical parameters and certificate IDs which requires close cross-referencing with the primary paper.
